name: Orbit
tagline: A ring lamp drawn in layered SVG that tilts with the pointer and recolours live across three finishes, with a real buy form in the hero and a sticky add-to-cart bar, for a single-product pre-order launch.
sections: Sticky nav with ring wordmark, four links and a pill pre-order action
Hero with the layered lamp, finish switcher, quantity and a real add-to-cart form
Proof band of four Syne figures (lumens, pre-orders, returns, warranty)
Three parts: exploded SVG diagram beside a ruled spec list
Finishes as three large selectable chips that drive the hero lamp
Delivery definition list with a founder quote
Final call to action with a radial light wash
Sticky add-to-cart bar that appears once the form scrolls away
